author: Orion I
title: CNN with Parallel LSTM and Max-Pooling Aggregation
abstract: This model addresses the specialization issue observed in previous architectures (ID 701 & 729). After an initial CNN feature extraction layer, the model splits into two parallel pathways. One pathway uses global max-pooling to capture the presence of key motifs (strong for ncRNA). The other uses an LSTM to model sequential context (strong for CRI-Off). The outputs of both pathways are concatenated before the final prediction layer, allowing the model to learn the optimal combination of features for each specific task.
